name: Thalassery
registryBasis: The official Ente Bhoomi camp-office table explicitly lists a Thalassery taluk and Thalassery village row with a digital survey camp office at Thottummal Thalasseri. This establishes city-bound survey/land-record infrastructure, rather than relying on the Kannur district office alone. No public vector geometry was verified.
